criteria_scores.name: Hook strength

criteria_scores.name: Claim load-bearing + AK stakes
criteria_scores.rationale: The corrected distinction directly affects ANC 8(a) sole-source justifications, GAO audit outcomes, and Koniag's past-performance file.

criteria_scores.name: Steelman fairness
criteria_scores.rationale: Paras 2-3 generously affirm the CEO's credibility, AWS corroboration, and the VP quote, with no snark before the rebuttal.

criteria_scores.name: Counter-evidence quality
criteria_scores.rationale: AWS case study (primary, reverified) robustly establishes 'cost avoidance' language; the GAO categorical distinction lacks a cited primary URL though it traces to the dossier more_accurate_frame.

criteria_scores.name: Factual density
criteria_scores.rationale: Named specifics appear in nearly every sentence of paras 1-3 and recur through the stakes paragraph.

criteria_scores.name: Source quality
criteria_scores.rationale: Both attribution and primary counter trace to the dossier; the GAO distinction is asserted without a cited primary URL.

criteria_scores.name: Voice match
criteria_scores.rationale: Analytical, structural, corrective-not-contemptuous; brand register precise, no banned phrases, curly quotes correct.

criteria_scores.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
